name: baoyu-cover-image
tagline_zh: 写文配图总踩坑？五维参数混搭11色板×7渲染，电影宽屏到方图一键出片，连配文情绪都替你调好。
tagline_en: Stuck on cover art? Mix 5 dims, 11 palettes, 7 renders—cinematic to square, mood text auto-tuned.
desc_en: Generates article cover images with 5 dimensions (type, palette, rendering, text, mood) combining 11 color palettes and 7 rendering styles. Supports cinematic (2.35:1), widescreen (16:9), and square (1:1) aspects. Use when user asks to "generate cover image", "create article cover", or "make cover".
why_zh: 同类只会套模板，它把类型、配色、渲染、文字、情绪拆成可组合的积木，每次出图都是新配方。
why_en: Unlike template-only tools, it breaks covers into 5 combinable dims—every output is a fresh recipe, not a clone.
